ios.desc:
GitSync is a git client that simplifies syncing a folder between a git remote and a local directory. With a simple one-time setup, it keeps your files synced using background tasks, Siri shortcuts, home screen widgets, and manual triggers.

Supports iOS 13+

AUTHENTICATE
• HTTP/S
• SSH
• OAuth (GitHub, GitLab, Gitea)

CLONE & SYNC
• Clone a remote repository (with optional shallow history)
• Fetch, pull, stage, commit, push
• Resolve merge conflicts
• Retry automatically when the network returns

SYNC MECHANISMS
• On a recurring schedule (Enhanced Scheduled Sync, in-app purchase)
• From a home screen widget (Force Sync and Manual Sync)
• From an iOS Shortcut or Automation (including Siri)
• From a custom URL intent (advanced)

BROWSE & EDIT IN-APP
• File explorer with code editor and image viewer
• Recent commits plus file, line, and commit diffs
• Branch management (create, rename, delete, checkout)
• Multiple remotes (add, rename, delete, set URL)

GITHUB & GITLAB INTEGRATION (when signed in via OAuth)
• View, comment on, and create issues
• View, comment on, and create pull requests
• View workflow runs (GitHub Actions)

AI FEATURES
• Chat about your repository
• Wand auto-complete on text fields like commit messages
• Agent that can run repo actions for you
• Separate model selection for chat, tools, and the wand
• A global toggle to hide all AI features

REPOSITORY SETTINGS
• Signed commits
• Customisable sync commit messages
• Author details
• Edit .gitignore and .git/info/exclude
• Git filters: Git LFS and git-crypt
• Disable SSL verification per repo

MANAGE MULTIPLE REPOSITORIES via containers.

OPTIONAL IN-APP PURCHASES
• Premium — unlocks additional repositories, Git LFS, git-crypt, priority issue tagging
• AI subscription — hosted AI for chat, wand, and agent (monthly credit cap)
• Enhanced Scheduled Sync — recurring background sync with configurable intervals
• Or become a GitHub Sponsor to unlock premium.

ENTERPRISE
Organisations can provision premium and AI access via an enterprise code with email verification. Admins can revoke access at any time.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://gitsync.viscouspotenti.al/wiki/privacy-policy

> it died with apple making it impossible to offer any sort of generic filesystem API or even background sync

Apple's cloud storage remained WebDAV a very very long time.

Apple's iOS has a pluggable Files system.  Use Working Copy to give other apps access to folders sync'd with git: https://workingcopy.app

Or a dedicated app like GitSync:  https://apps.apple.com/us/app/gitsync/id6744980427
